description: Help Scout shared inbox helpdesk with Inbox API, Docs API and webhooks for developers.
auth_notes: Inbox API uses OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows, tokens sent in Authorization header). Docs API uses an API key passed via HTTP Basic auth as the username.
gate_detail: Developer creates an OAuth2 app under Your Profile > My apps; credentials must belong to an active invited user. Docs API keys need a Docs permission granted by an Account Owner or Administrator. A Free plan exists; API availability by plan is not stated.
api_scope: Inbox API for conversations, threads, tags, users, workflows and webhooks; Docs API for articles, collections, categories and sites; Chat API and webhooks also listed.
mcp_notes: No vendor MCP server appears in the provided sources.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate stated for creating an OAuth app; Docs API key needs an admin-granted permission.

evidence.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization , implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.
Create one by navigating to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.
The API key is passed via HTTP Basic Authentication and goes in the username field. A dummy password, such as X, goes in the password field.
Inbox API - read and write data to Help Scout inboxes
Webhooks - get notified about activity in Help Scout

uncertainties: Whether the Free plan includes API access is not stated.
Source S1 is truncated; rate limits and full webhook details not seen.
